title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：race　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 race 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the athlete ① ran the race that no trainer in the stadium would have described, and he said the running was the whole of the year. The ② race, meaning the contest itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a race, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ race in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ race at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A race, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the athlete said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the race was the whole of the matter, meaning the speed and not the contest. The ⑥ race, meaning the speed and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; race, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a contest and a speed. He said the speed is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ race had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ race of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of describing; race, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ race I remember is the contest described in the programme, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ race, my mother said in 1978, is the only contest that improves by being described; every race, she said, is a speed that has agreed to look like a contest. She said the speed was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 赛跑；比赛（指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 赛跑；比赛（指那场赛跑本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：run the race 跑这一场赛跑
D. n. 赛跑；比赛（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 赛跑之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的赛跑之事）
F. n. 赛跑；比赛（指秩序册里写到、被描述的那一场）
G. n. 赛跑、快慢（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 快慢（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ran the race that no trainer in the stadium would have described
The race, meaning the contest itself and not the bib
the race at the far track
the race was the whole of the matter
the race had become a line in a programme
The race of the whole thing
A race, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: run the race 意为“跑这一场赛跑”，1969 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯描述的一场赛跑做了一遍。
race 意为“赛跑；比赛”，指那场赛跑本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被描述。
race 意为“赛跑；比赛”，指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
race 意为“赛跑；比赛”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
race 意为“赛跑、快慢”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场快慢就是那件事的全部。
race 意为“快慢”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场赛跑，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
race 意为“赛跑；比赛”，指秩序册里写到、被描述的那一场，到 1974 年这一场成了秩序册里的一行。
race 意为“赛跑之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的赛跑之事是一处体育场和三个年份的描述。
race 意为“赛跑；比赛”，我记得的是秩序册里描述过的那一场，1976 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一场。
race 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，赛跑是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的赛跑。
